name: Porto/Post/Doc 2026 - À Noite
description: Porto/Post/Doc screens Beatrice Gibson's film À Noite at Batalha Centro de Cinema in Porto.
longDescription:
Porto/Post/Doc presents a screening of À Noite (At Night), directed by Beatrice Gibson, as part of the festival's International Competition. The 87-minute fiction and experimental work follows six women crossing paths across neon-lit Paris over the course of a single night.

The screening takes place in Sala 2 at Batalha Centro de Cinema on 27 November 2026 at 21:30. General admission tickets cost 5€, with reduced tickets available for 3.75€.
